'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Matt Sokol DS ISB Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Sokol]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|SE-D-isboperations.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Matthew Sokol
* '''Deck name:''' ISB Blah
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
